summary: Dropbox filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive agreement, entered November 3, 2026, to acquire all outstanding equity of Tigris Data Inc., a globally distributed object storage platform built for AI workloads, for approximately $350 million in cash subject to customary purchase price adjustments. The same release announced the launch of DBX Agent Cloud, a storage and data infrastructure offering. Closing is expected in Q4 2026, subject to customary conditions; no board recommendation, advisor, financing, break fee, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch integration and retention risk and whether the cash deal draws balance-sheet scrutiny.
